---
title: "Changes in racial self-identification (bias-corrected)"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Estimate raw and bias-adjusted racial passing rates (Black in 1940 Census
→ White in Numident) 


```{r setup}
## library packages 
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

```{r load-data}
numident <- vroom(
  here("data", "censoc_numident_w_initials.csv.zip"),
  col_select = c("HISTID", "middle_A", "middle_B", "byear", "INCWAGE",
                 "death_age", "SEX", "EDUC", "RACE", "RELATE", "MARST",
                 "SEI", "link_abe_exact_conservative", "race_first"),
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

# First letter of middle name in each source
numident$middle_name_census   <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_a)
numident$middle_name_numident <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_b)
```

```{r recode}
numident <- numident %>%
  mutate(
    race_numident = case_when(
      race_first == 1 ~ "White",
      race_first == 2 ~ "Black"
    ),
    race_census = case_when(
      race == 100 ~ "White",
      race == 200 ~ "Black"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(sex == 1)
```

```{r quick-check}
# Sanity check: raw passing rates by ABE conservative flag
numident %>%
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920, race_census == "Black") %>%
  group_by(link_abe_exact_conservative) %>%
  summarize(passing_rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n())
```

## Core function: adjust passing rate within a single linked sample

The function takes a data frame that is ALREADY restricted to the linked sample of
interest (e.g., only ABE Standard links, or only ABE Conservative links). All three
quantities in Equation 6 are computed on this same sample.

```{r adjust-fn}
adjust_passing_rate <- function(linked_data, birth_year_range = 1910:1920) {

  # Full linked sample (cohort-restricted)
  s_full <- linked_data %>%
    filter(byear %in% birth_year_range)

  # Validation subsample: records with both middle initials observed
  s_val <- s_full %>%
    filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident))

  # --- Quantities on the VALIDATION subsample ---
  f_r <- s_val %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident)) %>%
    pull(rate)

  R_obs_val <- s_full %>%
    filter(race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(rate)

  R_false <- s_val %>%
    filter(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident,
           race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(rate)

  # R_hat_true: Eq. 6 applied to the validation subsample
  R_hat_true <- (R_obs_val - R_false * f_r) / (1 - f_r)

  # Adjustment factor from validation subsample
  adjustment_factor <- R_hat_true / R_obs_val

  # --- R' on the FULL linked sample (including records without middle initials) ---
  R_prime <- s_full %>%
    filter(race_census == "Black") %>%
    summarize(rate = mean(race_numident == "White", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(rate)

  # Eq. 7: scale R' by the adjustment factor
  R_true <- R_prime * adjustment_factor

  tibble(
    R_true            = R_true,
    R_prime           = R_prime,
    R_hat_true        = R_hat_true,
    R_obs_val         = R_obs_val,
    R_false           = R_false,
    f_r               = f_r,
    adjustment_factor = adjustment_factor,
    n_total           = nrow(s_full),
    n_validation      = nrow(s_val)
  )
}
```

## Point estimates by linked sample

```{r point-estimates}
# ABE Standard = all conservative + standard-not-conservative links.
# In the data, link_abe_exact_conservative is 0/1 indicating conservative status
# AMONG records that are standard links. Adjust the filter below if your link
# variable encoding differs.

abe_standard <- numident %>%
  filter(!is.na(link_abe_exact_conservative))   # i.e., is a standard link

abe_conservative <- numident %>%
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1)

abe_std_not_cons <- numident %>%
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 0)

result_standard         <- adjust_passing_rate(abe_standard)
result_conservative     <- adjust_passing_rate(abe_conservative)
result_std_not_cons     <- adjust_passing_rate(abe_std_not_cons)

bind_rows(
  result_standard     %>% mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard"),
  result_conservative %>% mutate(link_method = "ABE Conservative"),
  result_std_not_cons %>% mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard, Not Conservative")
)
```

```{r}
abe_standard %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>% 
  summarize(mean(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident), n())

abe_standard %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>%
  filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>% 
  filter(middle_name_census != middle_name_numident) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race_numident)) %>% 
  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  count(race_numident) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

abe_standard %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race_numident)) %>% 
  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  count(race_numident) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))


abe_standard %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)) %>% 
  filter(middle_name_census == middle_name_numident) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race_numident)) %>% 
  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  count(race_numident) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
  
```



## Bootstrap CIs

The bootstrap resamples *within* a fixed linked sample, so f_r, R_obs, and R_false
are all recomputed on the same resampled data each iteration — preserving the
within-sample consistency required by Equation 6.

```{r bootstrap-fn}
bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate <- function(linked_data,
                                          n_boot = 500,
                                          birth_year_range = 1910:1920) {

  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    total = n_boot,
    format = "Bootstrapping [:bar] :percent in :elapsed"
  )

  out <- vector("list", n_boot)

  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    pb$tick()

    sample_data <- linked_data %>%
      slice_sample(n = nrow(linked_data), replace = TRUE)

    out[[i]] <- tryCatch(
      adjust_passing_rate(sample_data, birth_year_range),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out) %>%
    summarize(
      adj_mean     = mean(R_true,  na.rm = TRUE),
      adj_lower_ci = quantile(R_true, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      adj_upper_ci = quantile(R_true, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      obs_mean     = mean(R_obs,   na.rm = TRUE),
      obs_lower_ci = quantile(R_obs,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      obs_upper_ci = quantile(R_obs,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}
```

```{r run-bootstrap}
set.seed(20260507)

bootstrap_standard <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(abe_standard) %>%
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard")

bootstrap_conservative <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(abe_conservative) %>%
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Conservative")

bootstrap_std_not_cons <- bootstrap_adjust_passing_rate(abe_std_not_cons) %>%
  mutate(link_method = "ABE Standard, Not Conservative")
```

## Fastlink results (precomputed elsewhere using the same method)

```{r fastlink}
fastlink <- tibble(
  adj_mean     = 0.069609,
  adj_lower_ci = 0.063909,
  adj_upper_ci = 0.07539,
  obs_mean     = 0.225058437,
  obs_lower_ci = 0.221697057,
  obs_upper_ci = 0.228326108,
  link_method  = "Fastlink"
)
```

## Combine and plot

```{r combine}
results <- bind_rows(
  bootstrap_standard,
  bootstrap_conservative,
  bootstrap_std_not_cons,
  fastlink
)

results_long <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -link_method,
    names_to  = c("type", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(adj|obs)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type, adj = "Adjusted", obs = "Observed"))
```

```{r plot}
# Reference line: average adjusted rate across the two methods shown in the main figure
mean_adj <- results_long %>%
  filter(link_method %in% c("ABE Conservative", "Fastlink"),
         type == "Adjusted") %>%
  summarize(m = mean(mean)) %>%
  pull(m)

passing_fig <- results_long %>%
  filter(link_method %in% c("ABE Conservative", "Fastlink")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = link_method, y = mean, ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci,
             color = type)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_adj, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(y = "Passing Rate", x = "Linking Method", color = "Estimate Type") +
  ylim(0, 0.25) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ggsci::scale_color_lancet()

ggsave(
  plot = passing_fig,
  filename = here("figures", "07_passing_fig.png"),
  bg = "white", height = 4.5, width = 9
)

passing_fig
```
